notes: Housekeeping stage 2 only: centralises visible build/version identity and JavaScript cache-busting around version.json. index.html now reads version.json with no-store, creates the single SAFETY_BUILD value, applies all visible version labels from it, and loads the existing app/hotfix scripts in the same order using the current build_id as their cache token. Older feature hotfixes no longer overwrite the build number with their own historical versions. version.json is also included in the offline shell cache. No workflow, database or navigation behaviour is intentionally changed. Includes all v2.10.44 navigation tidy and prior features.
